title: A locally injective map into a sheaf induces an injective map on the sheafification
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] on which presheaves of abelian groups have sheafifications, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of rings on $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules with sheafification $\eta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f:\mathcal P\to\mathcal F$ a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules and $f^\#:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal F$ the unique morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules with $f^\#\circ\eta=f$. Suppose $f$ is *locally injective*: for every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$ and every $x\in\mathcal P(V)$ with $f_V(x)=0$ there is a covering $\{V_k\to V\}_k$ of $\mathcal C$ such that $x|_{V_k}=0$ in $\mathcal P(V_k)$ for every $k$. Then $f^\#_W:\mathcal P^\#(W)\to\mathcal F(W)$ is injective for every object $W$ of $\mathcal C$; in particular $f^\#$ is a monomorphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules. (Proof sketch for the splitter: by Stacks Sites, Lemma 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification), applied to the underlying presheaf of sets of $\mathcal P$, whose sheafification is the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal P^\#$ (Sites, Section 00YR; Modules on Sites, Lemma 03CY), a section $t\in\mathcal P^\#(W)$ with $f^\#(t)=0$ is locally of the form $\eta(x_i)$ with $x_i\in\mathcal P(W_i)$; then $f(x_i)=f^\#(t)|_{W_i}=0$, so $x_i$ vanishes on a covering of $W_i$, hence so does $t$, and $t=0$ as $\mathcal P^\#$ is a sheaf.)
